title: LOCAL_RETURN_ISLAND_MOAT

geometry.island_basis: smallest axis-aligned local-u/v rectangle containing the tested M7B under-pad footprint and the full projected EXPOSED_PADDLE / three-paddle-via return region

scientific_change: From the canonical full-E2C backside ground, retain a branch-local copper island beneath the CIN/RFIN path and all three paddle-via return contacts, while etching a closed 0.25-mm copper moat around that island. No signal, package-top ground, via, port or radiator geometry changes.
target_mechanism: Preserve the local RF reference that M7B removed, while preventing the CIN-coupled local return node from being a broad low-impedance part of the surrounding/shared backside sheet.
first_principles_prediction: If M7B's large Sdd penalty was caused by loss of local reference while full-E2C Sdc/asymmetry came from coupling that reference into a shared/non-ideal return sheet, M7C should keep most of the M7B symmetry improvement and simultaneously restore the differential self-loading toward the isolated baseline.
falsification: If branch asymmetry remains suppressed but Sdd improves by less than 10% versus M7B, loss of local return reference is not sufficient to explain the M7B penalty or this topology fails to restore it. If Sdd improves but Sdc/asymmetry returns above 50% of full-E2C, the moat does not isolate the shared return strongly enough.

preregistered_future_solve_gate.primary_symmetry: For both polarizations at all five anchors, |Delta Sdc| versus the corresponding isolated baseline <= 0.25 times the full-E2C |Delta Sdc| at the same anchor.
preregistered_future_solve_gate.primary_differential_restoration: For both polarizations at 1.3432, 1.5752 and 1.6496 GHz, |Delta Sdd| versus isolated baseline <= 0.70 times the M7B |Delta Sdd| at the same anchor.
preregistered_future_solve_gate.secondary_raw: Worst own-pol source-side complex deviation over 1.15-1.65 GHz <= 0.80 times the M7B worst value (reference worst=0.8208781601757584; threshold=0.6567025281406067).
preregistered_future_solve_gate.guard: No new >6 dB off-diagonal excursion in any <=50 MHz window; numerical hard gates must pass.

classification.PASS_M7C_LOCAL_RETURN_ISLAND: numerical gates pass AND symmetry primary passes AND differential-restoration primary passes AND guard passes
classification.REVIEW_M7C_PARTIAL: numerical/guard pass and exactly one primary family passes or at least one failed primary improves >=10% in the predicted direction
classification.REJECT_M7C_LOCAL_RETURN_TOPOLOGY: numerical/guard pass and neither primary family demonstrates >=10% predicted improvement
classification.HOLD_M7C_GUARD: numerical gates pass but guard fails

comparison_authority.m6_d2: INTERMEDIATE ground/backside/via contribution but not scaled full-E2C copy
comparison_authority.m7b: REVIEW_M7B_PARTIAL_CORRECTION; Sdc/asymmetry strongly suppressed but Sdd self-loading worsened 2.25-3.60x full-E2C at diagnostic anchors
